title: Tube Filling Sarstedt Tubes in Custom 12-, 24-, or 48-Tube Racks
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Pick up tip
steps.instruction: Pick up a fresh tip from the specified tip‑rack location (e.g., A1‑H12) using the selected single‑channel pipette mounted on the chosen side.

steps.title: Transfer solution to first rack
steps.instruction: Using the chosen dispense mode (transfer or distribute), aspirate the defined Transfer Volume (µL) from the source container (15 mL or 50 mL Falcon conical tube or Beckman Coulter reservoir) and dispense it into every Sarstedt screw‑cap tube of the first rack (slot 2). The rack may be a 12‑well, 24‑well, or 48‑well format, and the tubes may be 0.5 mL, 1.5 mL, or 2 mL.

substeps.instruction: If Touch Tip is enabled, perform a touch‑tip after each dispense.
Verify that the source container holds at least the Starting Stock Volume (in mL) specified for the run.

steps.title: Repeat for remaining racks
steps.instruction: Repeat the transfer/distribute operation for each additional rack, up to a total of nine racks, using the same volume and parameters.

steps.title: Discard tip
steps.instruction: Eject the used tip into the waste bin.
